name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Onboarding & Implementation Specialist | High-Volume SaaS Onboarding, Time to Activation, Salesforce
summary: Client onboarding and implementation specialist with 15+ years in SaaS, most of it working with small-business owners. At Wix I carried a book of up to ~25 concurrent onboardings, launched 25+ clients per month, and held 110% of implementation targets by keeping every client moving toward their launch date. At Birdeye I onboarded 15-20 reseller partners in Salesforce and retained all but one. I use AI tools daily to draft client communications, build workflows, and keep a high-volume book organized.

experience.title: Client Onboarding & Implementation — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for small-business clients, translating business requirements into system setup and running hands-on training for owners and staff.
Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, LLM APIs) to draft client communications, build workflows, and cut manual follow-up across the client book.
Built automated appointment booking with confirmations, reminders, and no-show recovery, plus post-sale onboarding sequences that keep clients moving without manual chasing.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping records auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts, resolving feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention, and advised on budget planning for accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention), with all activity tracked in Salesforce.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration, handling 50+ partner activities per day.
Analyzed partner utilization metrics to spot stalled or low-adoption accounts early and step in before they churned.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Served a banking-industry client and helped pursue a major northeastern U.S. banking prospect, reaching finalist stage.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment, while serving as sales team lead.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month with up to ~25 concurrent onboardings, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Kept each client on track to launch as primary contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.
Led and trained onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists through weekly sessions and 1:1 coaching, for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.
Defined the Salesforce fields required for onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team.
Walked professional-services firms through Accelo's invoicing and billing features, showing how time, projects, and billing connect in one system.
Escalated setup issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct guidance.
